unit_department: Department of Plant and Soil Science, Davis College of Agricultural Sciences & Natural Resources
description_1line: Texas Tech institute for fiber and biopolymer research, development, testing, and textile manufacturing, serving university researchers, cotton breeders, public agencies, and textile manufacturers from the raw fiber stage through the finished textile product.
facilities_note: 110,000-square-foot institute located approximately six miles east of the main campus; laboratories include the Cotton Phenomics Laboratory (in-depth physical testing and evaluation for fibers, yarns, and fabrics; HVI, AFIS and FAVIMAT measurements), the Spinning Evaluation Laboratory (ring spinning, compact spinning, and open-end rotor spinning machinery), and the Micro-Gin Lab with transparently-sided scaled-down commercial Lummus cotton ginning equipment.
